title: Refynd
description: A scalable EV rental marketplace with configurable pricing and an enquiry-to-order workflow. Includes an administrative dashboard for user management, enquiries, and order tracking.

title: Multi-Tenant School Management System
description: A multi-tenant SaaS platform enabling isolated school data and onboarding for 1,000+ students and staff per tenant, with admissions, attendance, examinations, report cards, fees, notifications, analytics, and role-based access control.

title: AI-Powered PDF Q&A Assessment System
description: An AI-powered learning system that uses uploaded PDF documents to ask questions about their content, evaluates submitted answers, and marks each response as correct or incorrect.
